steps.text: Fund US$300 via card or transfer to activate the trading balance.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Choose the risk settings and execution mode, then start with the practice balance.

pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
cons: Support channels not clearly listed.
Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
No independent audit of the models.
Broker relationship described vaguely.
redFlags: A broker relationship described in one vague sentence.
Ownership details missing from the public pages.
The demo promised in the pitch but buried in the flow.

faqs.a: US$300, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.
8 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$300, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$300 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
The verdict holds at 4.8: research it, demo it, and if you fund it, fund the minimum. The platform earns a careful start, not blind trust.
